parts.name: Outside Frame
parts.Basic_description: The outside frame of a door set, typically made of wood, forming the structural boundary that supports the door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and alignment for the door, ensuring smooth opening and closing while securing the door in place.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move; it serves as the fixed boundary for the door’s rotation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The main door panel of the door set, made of wood, designed to open and close within the frame.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the movable barrier that allows or restricts access through the doorway, providing privacy and security.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the frame, allowing it to swing open or closed.
